truth: The source provides two separate campaign modes; select one before dungeon initialization.

choices.label: Help the parents recover their four kidnapped children

nodes.freeText: Players may refuse, negotiate or investigate. If they later enter the dungeon without a formal contract, choose the room-14 variant according to the established fiction and never merge variants.

truth: Crawl mode originates at the mill; rescue mode originates at a leather-worker's cellar.

choices.label: Speak to the kidnapped children's family

nodes.freeText: Allow ordinary local investigation without inventing additional hidden masterminds or alternate kidnappers.

truth: The crawl tunnel opens above the floor; a differently coloured stone marks the ceiling spear-trap trigger.
nodes.freeText: Reward source-supported caution. Do not invent a second trap.

truth: East and west routes are available; secret shrine access depends on discovery/key state.
nodes.freeText: Use source map topology. Secret doors are not automatically found because a player asks generally.

truth: This is a protected sanctuary; the healing chalice functions only here.

choices.label: Use holy water with the chalice

nodes.freeText: The chalice loses its special healing function outside this room.

truth: One pit is open; one is concealed and spiked; the hidden-shrine key is on the corpse below the southern pit.
nodes.freeText: Permit ropes, poles, bridging and other reasonable tactics. Preserve actual pit depths/triggers.

truth: Wading through the sludge is safe; probing/searching can disturb the centipede nest.
nodes.freeText: Do not trigger centipedes merely for entering; disturbance is the source condition.

truth: The east passage eventually exits into a concealed outside cavern.
nodes.freeText: Once discovered, persist the outside route as a valid later entry/exit.

truth: Opening the door normally brings the opener into the swinging axe path.
nodes.freeText: Allow careful source-consistent avoidance.

truth: There is no secret door and the painted/yellow button does nothing.
nodes.freeText: Repeated searching returns no new passage. Never create one as a reward for persistence.

truth: Six kobolds are hiding from their chieftain after stealing part of the tribal treasure.
nodes.freeText: Negotiation, recruitment, intimidation or betrayal may emerge, but source does not define a guaranteed alliance.

truth: Green Slime hangs in the central ceiling and responds to creatures/objects reaching beneath it.
nodes.freeText: Use environmental geometry rather than making the slime pursue beyond source behaviour without cause.

truth: Each thorough search interval has a small source-defined chance of producing one random result from a mixed reward/hazard table.
nodes.freeText: Never choose only favourable results. Apply the source random table faithfully.

truth: The grizzled hobgoblin is neutral unless attacked and trades information for coin using ESP and local knowledge.
nodes.freeText: Broker statements can mix useful truth and lies. Do not promote unverified broker claims to hard canon.

truth: Five orcs are focused on removing a glowing skull; in rescue mode they are prospective slavers/buyers for the children.
nodes.freeText: In rescue mode, knowledge about the impending child sale may affect negotiation if learned elsewhere.

truth: Four skeletons stay inert unless attacked or the sarcophagus is touched.
nodes.freeText: Do not animate the guardians merely because characters enter.

truth: Four children are captive in a suspended cage; five kobolds and their chieftain are debating ransom or sale to the Room 12 orcs.

choices.label: Create a distraction and lower the cage

nodes.freeText: Support creative rescue plans. The children remain physically suspended until the cage is lowered/reached safely.

truth: Success requires getting the four children free/alive, not merely defeating the kobolds.

choices.label: Escort the children back to their parents

nodes.freeText: Track child safety while further exploring. Do not auto-teleport captives home.

truth: The room contains a fallen iron bird cage, a crushed goblin and seven loose stirges.

choices.label: Search the crushed goblin after handling the threat

nodes.freeText: There are no children or chieftain in this mode.

truth: Previously discovered routes, hazards, deaths, negotiations and mode remain persistent.

choices.label: Continue to an unexplored connected room

nodes.freeText: Use actual map connections. Do not reset rooms after retreat.

truth: Surface reward depends on the accepted hook and actual evidence/rescue result.

choices.label: Return later and continue dungeon exploration

nodes.freeText: Do not pay both contracts unless both were independently established and fulfilled.

endings.summary: The party returns under the bounty/crawl contract and receives only the reward actually supported by proof and the agreed terms.
The four children are returned alive to their family; the rescue reward and family outcome resolve according to actual events.
The party withdraws or leaves objectives incomplete; dungeon state persists for later return.
Negotiated kobold/orc/broker outcomes may continue into homebrew campaign state, clearly separated from source canon.
